free_tier.stated: No published storage cap. Explicitly excluded from the per-project 10 GiB limit; unlimited container repositories per project is the practical reading.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: The storage quota page excludes the container registry from the 10 GiB project storage limit, which covers only the project repository and LFS.

retention.stated: An optional per-project cleanup policy (a scheduled job) removes tags matching a regex pattern. Untagged image layers are automatically deleted after 24 hours if they remain unreferenced.
retention.notes: Untagged image layers are automatically deleted after 24 hours if they remain unreferenced. After a user deletes a tag, a garbage collection run is scheduled to start 24 hours later. The tag cleanup policy is a scheduled job.

egress.terms: Free, Cloudflare + Google Cloud CDN. Blob requests 307-redirect to cdn.registry.gitlab-static.net with a signed URL. Directly cacheable by an external Cloudflare zone.

tooling: Standard OCI Distribution v2. ORAS, skopeo, crane, docker. Auth flow is anonymous for public projects (`/jwt/auth` returns a token with auth_type=none). Authorization token duration on GitLab.com is 15 minutes.
chaining: One OCI artifact per blob of any size -> unlimited projects x unlimited repositories x unlimited tags. This is the canonical 'OCI registry as object store' pattern (ORAS). Blob dedupe means the same chunk stored in N projects costs one copy but is addressable N times.
limits_note: Renaming a project with populated container repositories is limited to projects with up to 1,000 container repositories.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: er repos is blocked. Public pulls are rate-limited loosely; anonymous token issuance works but each pull needs a token round-trip. registry
